issue.title: agy trajectory tool-call extraction and structural no-progress detection are silently off on agy 1.2.7 (version allowlist stuck at 1.0.10)
issue.description:
Found while researching agy usage-window collection (research:202609/agy_usage_window_collection__cld.md).

`_SUPPORTED_AGY_TRAJECTORY_VERSIONS = frozenset({"1.0.10"})` in `src/sase/llm_provider/_subprocess_agy.py` has not changed since the extractor landed (6c661bbdb, 2026-06-20). The installed Antigravity CLI is now `agy 1.2.7`. Its conversation DBs still live under `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversations/` (60 `*.db` files on athena).

Because the version is not allowlisted, `prepare_agy_tool_call_extraction()` returns `None` on every agy run. Two things are off as a result:

- Trajectory tool-call extraction. No `tool_calls.jsonl` rows are written for agy runs.
- Structural no-progress detection (`analyze_agy_turn_progress`). agy no-progress recovery falls back to the text-only heuristic.

Nothing logs this. It is only recoverable via `SASE_AGY_TOOL_TRAJECTORY_VERSION_ALLOWLIST`, which is unset.

Remediation needs a decision, which is why this is sized large:

- (a) Verify the private trajectory decoder (`_tool_call_agy.normalize_agy_trajectory_steps`) against agy 1.2.x DBs, then widen the gate to a tested range or floor.
- (b) Replace the private-DB path with agy's now-documented `--output-format stream-json` print mode. This arrived around 1.1.x; the provider docstring still says no JSON mode exists.

Whichever path is chosen, also emit a one-time diagnostic when the gate disables extraction, so this cannot silently regress again on the next agy release.

task_type_fields.impact: Every agy agent run records no tool-call rows and skips structural no-progress detection, silently degrading agy observability and no-progress recovery to the text heuristic.
task_type_fields.repro: .venv/bin/python -c "from sase.llm_provider._subprocess_agy import _agy_version, _agy_version_supports_trajectory, prepare_agy_tool_call_extraction as p; print(_agy_version('agy'), _agy_version_supports_trajectory('agy'), p('agy', artifacts_dir='/tmp/x'))"  -> prints: 1.2.7 False None (agy 1.2.7 installed; conversations dir populated)

evidence.note: Independently reproduced by the lead researcher consolidating the agy usage-window research (2026-09-21, sase @ 87c604833): _subprocess_agy.py:24 still has _SUPPORTED_AGY_TRAJECTORY_VERSIONS = frozenset({'1.0.10'}), SASE_AGY_TOOL_TRAJECTORY_VERSION_ALLOWLIST is unset in the agent env, and the installed binary reports agy --version -> 1.2.7, so the allowlist gate rejects every current run.
